parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It extends from the hinge to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and holds the glasses in place by resting over the ear.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of durable plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the eyeglasses on the wearer’s head and ensures a balanced fit.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame front of the eyeglasses, typically made of metal, holding the lenses and connecting both legs.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses, provides structural integrity, and connects to the nose pads and temple arms.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and rigid, serving as the central structural component of the eyeglasses.
